_doc: Drift / hajwala layer (src/game/driveController.ts, src/game/driveSession.ts). assist = automatic counter-steer toward the direction of travel while the body slides: (slip - deadband + rateGain[s] * slip rate) / steering lock, faded by fadeWithInput * |player steer|; past maxAngleDeg the throttle is cut linearly over throttleFadeDeg down to minThrottle (settings: Drift assist). hud = drift angle + combo score. Angles in degrees, speeds in m/s.
